description: The East Kazakhstan snow-survey partnership publishes georeferenced measurements from 111 sites sampled between 27 February and 6 March 2025. The collection contains 2,331 snow-depth and 555 density measurements, plus calculated snow water equivalent, terrain, elevation and land-cover attributes. Zenodo provides site-level CSV files and a summary table in a ZIP archive freely under CC BY 4.0. These regional measurements can initialise snowmelt-runoff simulations or check remotely sensed snow products before flood and water-supply planning. The campaign targets maximum snow accumulation, so it does not describe seasonal evolution. Sampling spacing changes on steep terrain, limiting uniform spatial comparison. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: GEOREFERENCED SNOW DEPTH AND SNOW WATER EQUIVALENT DATASET (2025) FROM EAST KAZAKHSTAN REGION
